command: pre-registration: PLAN_PARTS Layer 1 (F1 role-mixing map, F2 mixing -> N2 failure, F3 purification)

metrics.F1: per VLA: holds iff some component (W, V, Rest, KV_l | Q_l, E_j), some direction (tg, op), has the compound-bootstrap CI lower bound of pooled m above floor_dir = max over A's components of A's CI upper bound; location k*_dir = argmax pooled m over {W, V, KV_l | Q_l}
metrics.F2: per VLA: ties iff rho_g (m_{k*_tg} vs 1-g, 22 grasp cells) > 0 with CI excluding 0, or rho_p (m_{k*_op} vs 1-p, 11 familiar place cells) > 0 with CI excluding 0; N2 main rollouts
metrics.F3: per VLA: purify k*_op on N1-N6 (familiar primary, states 4-13, 10 eps/task) against an intact re-run on the same branch seeds; ties iff delta pooled p > 0 with CI excluding 0 (bootstrap over tasks and states); open loop descriptive; if k*_op = V stop and report
metrics.go_kill: GO to Layer 2 iff for at least one VLA F1 holds and (F2 or F3) ties; else KILL K1
metrics.written_before: any F1 main run or read
